currency_exchange How the Premium Market works

You define the general settings, register the rotation villages and create per-village exceptions whenever you want. If the current village is registered, the main screen then edits its own settings.

scheduleAutomatic checking
shopping_cartBuy within target
sellSell within target
shopping_cart

Buy

Buys when the real rate is ≥ minimum rate you defined. Rate = resources received ÷ points spent. The higher, the better for you.

Example: target rate 80 → the script only buys if it receives at least 80 resources per point.
sell

Sell

Sells when the real rate is ≤ maximum rate you defined. Rate = resources spent ÷ points received. The lower, the better for you.

Example: target rate 100 → the script only sells if it spends at most 100 resources per point.
tune

Where to edit each thing

1
Main screen If the current village is registered in Villages, clicking Save here creates or updates its own settings. If it is not registered, saving changes the general settings.
2
Automatic overrides When you save from the main screen of a registered village, the script stores only the difference from the general settings. If a value becomes equal to the general one again, that override disappears.
3
Villages popup Use the Villages button to set up the rotation, add or removes villages and create, clear or review per-village settings.
Summary: everything not overridden by a village keeps inheriting the general settings.

1
Reads the market Every cycle, the script fetches current market data and recalculates buy and sell opportunities.
2
Applies your rules Target rate, active resources, chosen priority, minimum reserve and available capacity all feed the decision.
3
Runs safely Cross-tab protection avoids conflicts, the rate is verified before confirmation and the reserve prevents selling below the defined minimum.
